title: Dynasties and the Forbidden Land
summary: Great powers gather in Yan Capital to enter the Ancient Forbidden Land for immortality medicine, among them the Imperial Uncle and the dying Emperor of the Guhua Dynasty (one of the Four Great Immortal Dynasties of the Central States) and the Yin-Yang Sect with its Holy Maiden. Ji Ziyue has been brought to Yan Capital under the watch of four elders, and Ji Hui still wants Ye Fan dead. Disguised as Wang Chongxiao, Ye Fan steps in when Ji Hui's great-grandson (Four Poles) bullies Zhang Wenchang for refusing to give up Ye Fan, then leaves without revealing himself because someone is watching the old man. He takes in Nannan, who has lost her memories and not aged in three years, forges a stone robe with the Heavenly Source Book's binding seal and the nine ancient Dao characters, and gives Nannan a memory jade; in return she gives him her small colourful stone. The Guhua Emperor (Immortal Platform 2nd level) walks into the Forbidden Land in a divine robe and dies there. A young woman lends Ye Fan a holy robe on condition that she gets one immortality medicine, and agrees to look after Zhang Wenchang and Nannan if he doesn't come back.

flags: 'Kamu penggemar' throughout is a machine mistranslation of the name 'Ye Fan' (叶凡 read as 'you fan'); treated as Ye Fan.
